import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import
from src.service import import_contacts

def fresh():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    return c

def rejects(fn, *args):
    try:
        fn(*args)
    except ValueError:
        return True
    return False

c = fresh()
assert import_contacts(c, []) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": []}) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}

# Trim, lowercase, insert
assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "  Bob@Example.com ", "name": "  Bob "}]) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("bob@example.com", "Bob")]

# Existing email counts as updated even with same name; new one inserted
r = import_contacts(c, [{"email": "bob@example.com", "name": "Bob"}, {"email": "amy@x.io", "name": "Amy"}])
assert r == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1}, r
assert list_contacts(c) == [("amy@x.io", "Amy"), ("bob@example.com", "Bob")]

# Name update for existing
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": "amy@x.io", "name": "Amy Z"}]}) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1}
assert ("amy@x.io", "Amy Z") in list_contacts(c)

# add_contact still works
assert handle_add(c, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"}) == {"ok": True}

before = list_contacts(c)
bad_batches = [
    [{"email": "x@y", "name": "X"}, "not-a-dict"],
    [{"email": "x@y", "name": "X", "extra": 1}],
    [{"email": "x@y"}],
    [{"email": "x@@y", "name": "X"}],
    [{"email": "x", "name": "X"}],
    [{"email": "@y", "name": "X"}],
    [{"email": "x@", "name": "X"}],
    [{"email": "x y@z", "name": "X"}],
    [{"email": "x@y", "name": "   "}],
    [{"email": 1, "name": "X"}],
    [{"email": "x@y", "name": "X"}, {"email": " X@Y ", "name": "Z"}],  # duplicate after normalization
    [{"email": "new@q.com", "name": "N"}, {"email": "bad", "name": "B"}],  # valid + invalid -> nothing written
]
for batch in bad_batches:
    assert rejects(import_contacts, c, batch), batch
    assert list_contacts(c) == before, batch

for payload in [None, [], {}, {"contacts": None}, {"rows": []}, {"contacts": [], "x": 1}, {"contacts": {}}]:
    assert rejects(handle_import, c, payload), payload
    assert list_contacts(c) == before

# Database failure mid-batch rolls back everything
c.execute("CREATE TRIGGER boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'boom@x.io' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
c.commit()
failed = False
try:
    import_contacts(c, [{"email": "ok@x.io", "name": "Ok"}, {"email": "boom@x.io", "name": "Boom"}])
except sqlite3.Error:
    failed = True
assert failed
assert list_contacts(c) == before
c.close()
print("import checks passed")
